# Published baseline rebind

The adapter now binds published repair commit `ddd4a6a8df0f908a162b7e5387b0faac325180d6` and manifest SHA256 `67d686934ba718b50f8d14e1efa9e2c8dfbc96bc88e43d1a341b4719440509aa`. The manifest contains 339 files: 338 are unchanged from parent `2975d6d0b9111cc84adb82ccc673bc82339ab154`; only the independently reviewed transport test changed. This baseline remains distinct from the original source/capture and G34 producer.

Only `BASELINE_COMMIT` and `BASELINE_MANIFEST_SHA256` changed in the corrected adapter. The exact before/held snapshots and unified diff are retained here. All other adapter AST, the unchanged pure core, both current test sources and the v2 interface retain their previous identities. The production contract updates these two baseline identities and clarifies eight guarded promotion paths: six Python runtime files plus two contract documents. Adding the six Python files raises the runtime-manifest count to 345.

The six existing author baseline/context methods passed on the final source: 1.056 seconds unittest, 2.352111 seconds process. Their complete execution receipt and stdout/stderr are retained in `../receipts/final-baseline-rebind-first/`. This targeted run does not repeat or replace the earlier 60-method author result on the counter-corrected source. Independent review passed 13 source/Git/manifest checks and four existing generated guard methods: 1.677 seconds unittest, 4.7804294 seconds process. Source and runtime files stayed held. The independent receipts are recorded in their separate rebind handoff; root still owns exact integrated testing, publication, CI and package verification.

All earlier sources, first failures, corrections and passing executions remain historical evidence. In particular, the original 185-file report and its 78-file counter addendum are not overwritten. This rebind adds no source access, parser change, larger bound, scientific acceptance or actual-operation authorization. No actual Li source operation ran in this lane.

`../promotion-copyset.final.json` identifies the exact eight final promotion files and their hashes. It supersedes earlier pending copysets without altering them. The four portable test files contain 184 methods total; their exact integrated execution remains pending with root. Neither focused pass counts nor AST equality are a substitute for that run. The final rebind checks passed their first invocation; there is no new failed execution to relabel or omit.
